book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ba sa ba suunɛ lɛ ba yuuyɛ Jiso
Balɛt mo wu jo Jiso wu nya ba ndiinyɛ wu.
Bamii ba nchi lu kifo ki bvunfoŋ ki nyu mbiaŋmbiaŋ bo booŋ a wu fwa, bo jo njú yi bvunfoŋ yi yɛɛle lo, bo susɛ ye ye le.
Bo mo bo too fɛ wu le bo buune wu, bo duu lɛ, “Biaa yi bimbaaŋ! Nfoŋ Bajuu!” No bo gee noo, bo maamɛ wu bɛ chiaaŋ.
Balɛt ka wu bu akfuuŋ wu du bamii le lɛ, “Bɛŋ yɛŋ, mbvuse muh wunɛ nnya bɛŋ le, fi le lɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ mbaaŋ n'yɛŋ gɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jiale le le gɛ.”
Jiso mo wu bu wu too bɛ kifo ki mbiaŋ fwa mo njú yi bvunfoŋ ye le. Balɛt mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ nɛ muh wuyu wunɛ!”

No bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ doo bo yɛŋ wu le noo, bo mo bo tu bo wanɛ lo lɛ, “Tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le, tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le!” Balɛt jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ jô wu bɛ chiaaŋ yene bɛŋ tâ yi kintaaŋ le, nje mbaaŋ n'yɛŋ gɛ jialɛ che le gɛ.”
Bajuu baa chvuu wu le lɛ, “Bee kɛme nchi wese, nchi wuyu duunyi lɛ wù kɛme ki wu kwê, nje wu le wu jo kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu le Mwa Nyo.”
Balɛt doo wu yu njɛme wunɛ noo wù kɛme lo nfaaŋ baaŋ.
Bɛ Jiso tu jiŋ a kibuu le, wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Wo ja faaŋ?” Geenɛ Jiso gɛ chvuu lo fiɛɛ gɛ.
Balɛt biih Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ wo nyu wo jɛmɛ mɛne gɛ? Gɛ wo kee lɛ ŋkɛme bvuŋga ki nchinɛ wo le, ŋka ŋkɛme bvuŋga ki ndu ba ta wo yi kintaaŋ le gɛ?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ taŋlo wo kɛme bvuŋga a mɛ we njɛ ba le ba nya bvuŋga bvuyu wo le fɛwe sɛŋ gɛ. Noo, nje finɛ fiɛɛ muh wù nya mɛ chiaaŋ yo le wu kɛme kimbefɛ kì kuge ki fede kuŋ.”

content: Balɛt doo wu yu njɛmɛ wunɛ, wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wu goone je ki wu chînɛ wu le. Geenɛ Bajuu waŋ lo fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Nɛ wo moŋ lo wo chinɛ muh wunɛ le, tu gɛ wo nyu nsaa yi Kaisa wù Nfoŋ wù baaŋ wu Lum gɛ. Muh wuchii wù yuuse kikwɛɛ ke, lɛ wu le Nfoŋ le muh wu kimbanɛ wu Kaisa.”
Balɛt doo wu ka wu yu wunɛ njɛmɛ, wu mo wu bu bɛ Jiso, wu shii yi kinta ki nsa le, fɛ Kijusɛ kì ba tɛŋe lɛ ba jonɛ bɛ Ata, nyume a jɛ́ yi Ibulu le lɛ Gabata.
Gɛ̀ bee Juu chi Nseesɛ wu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, kife gɛ̀ bee wa njɛ juu bikaa yuufe ncho bifɛɛ. Balɛt jɛmɛ Bajuu le lɛ, “Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ nɛ Nfoŋ wene wunɛ!”

Bajuu baa tu bo wanɛ lo lɛ, “Gɛ̂nɛ lo bɛ wu, gɛ̂nɛ lo bɛ wu, tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le!” Balɛt biih bo le lɛ, “Nta Nfoŋ wene yi kintaaŋ le?” Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ chvuu wu le lɛ, “Gɛ bee kɛme Nfoŋ wumu fede Kaisa gɛ.”
Balɛt mo wu nya Jiso bo le lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo tâ yi kintaaŋ le.
Ba ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le
Bo mo bo jo Jiso bo bu bɛ wu. Wu tuu kintaaŋ ke wu gɛɛne fɛ ba tɛŋe lɛ Ŋgboge wu Kikwɛɛ, ba tɛŋe a jɛ́ yi Ibulu le lɛ Golgota.
Bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo ta wu fo yi kintaaŋ le, bo ta tɛ bamii bamu bafɛɛ yi bintaaŋ le, wumu anchiɛɛŋ, wumu aŋkoŋo, Jiso nyu antɛnɛɛ.
Balɛt tɛ saŋ fiɛɛ fimi ba ta yi kintaaŋ ki Jiso le. Fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ saŋ gɛ̀ bee lɛ, “Jiso wu Nasalɛ, Nfoŋ wu Bajuu.”
Bajuu ba duude gɛ̀ tɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ saŋ fiyu, nje fɛ ba gɛ̀ ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le fo gɛ̀ bee mbebe a kilaantɛŋ le, wu gɛ̀ saŋ fiɛɛ finɛ a jɛ́ yi Ibulu le bɛ yi Latiŋ mo a yi Glek le.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ Bajuu bo gɛɛŋ bo jɛmɛ Balɛt le lɛ, “Keefɛ wo sâŋ lɛ, ‘Nfoŋ wu Bajuu gɛ.’ Saŋ nyu lɛ, ‘Muh wunɛ duu lɛ wu le Nfoŋ wu Bajuu.’”
Balɛt chvuu bo le lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fì nsaŋ nle nsaŋ wa.”

No bamii ba nchi gɛ̀ ta wa Jiso yi kintaaŋ le, bo mo bo jo njú ye bo ga bikwɛɛ biboo le manjuu manɛh no bo gɛ̀ bee. Bo gɛ̀ jo mo kikuŋ ke. Geenɛ kikuŋ kinɛ ba gɛ̀ tuŋ lo abadaa le, kɛge kindoŋ le boge bude yi bikaa le.
Noo, bo mo bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Keefɛ besabɛŋ saayɛ kikuŋ kinɛ gɛ. Bee tuŋ kaŋ yu, be yɛŋ muh wù lé wu kɛ̂mɛ.” Finɛ fiɛɛ gɛ̀ kooshi ki fi gê fi to fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bo gɛ̀ ga njú yaŋ yi bikwɛɛ biboo le,
bo tuŋ kaŋ bɛ kikuŋ kaŋ.”

content: Noo, bamii ba nchi baa gɛ̀ ge gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fiyu finɛ.
Bikɛse bamu gɛ̀ lɛme fo mbebe yi kintaaŋ ki Jiso le. Bikɛse banɛ gɛ̀ bee bwe Jiso bɛ mwa bwe bwe Jiso wù kwɛse mo Mɛɛle wù kwɛ Kloba mo Mɛɛle Madaleŋ.
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu yɛŋ bwee le, mo mwa ye wu ŋgoo wɛɛ wù wu gɛ̀ koŋe, bo lɛme mbebe ye le, wu jɛmɛ bwee le lɛ,

content.text: “Kwɛse, bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, wunɛ le wa mwa yo.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu kaasɛ wu jɛmɛ tɛ mwa ye wu ŋgoo wɛɛ le lɛ,
Kɛge sege kɛɛ mwa ye wu ŋgoo wɛɛ mo wu jo bwe Jiso wu gɛɛŋ bɛ wu tu bo chee wa nyu a wu yeh.
Jiso kwe
Ajiŋ ayu no Jiso gɛ̀ kee lɛ fiɛɛ fichii le fi ka wa, wu mo wu ja ki wu gê fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
Ŋkonyi wumu gɛ̀ bee fo bɛ mbvuuŋ ma ŋgbwamɛ mo yisɛ yo. Bamii ba nchi baa mo bo fuuŋ kfusha yo bo booŋ yi finte fi isob le bo chiaasɛ we fɛ jwe we le.
Jiso doo wu fi mbvuuŋ maa wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu ŋgvuusɛ kikwɛɛ, kiyo ke mo ki bu.
Ba booŋ chita chi Jiso

No abvu gɛ̀ bee juu chi nseesɛ ki bo lee juu chi yuuŋ le, Bajuu tu bo goone ki bo ge lɛ keefɛ agvuŋ ayu mɛ yi bintaaŋ le juu chi yuuŋ gɛ, (tete yuuŋ chiyu gɛ̀ bee chi baaŋ). Bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ Balɛt le bo lɛgɛ lɛ wu du bo ŋgoojɛ bikaa bi bamii ba gɛ̀ bee yi bintaaŋ le baa fi fɛ bo yaŋsɛ bo kweeyɛ ba shiishɛ bo, ba chiaasɛ.
Noo, bamii ba nchi mo bo to bo ŋgoojɛ bikaa bi muh wù fwe wɛɛ, bo ŋgoojɛ tɛ bi muh mu wɛɛ wù ba gɛ̀ ta bɛ wu.
Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ doo bo to bo bu fɛ Jiso le, bo yɛŋ lɛ wu le wu kwe wa, bo gɛ ka bo ŋgoojɛ bikaa bie gɛ.
Muh mu ŋgoo yi bamii ba nchi le booŋ chita chi Jiso bɛ gooŋ. No wu bonɛ noo, kimimia kilɛmɛ bɛ joo ta bu fo.
Muh wù gɛ̀ yɛŋ mwɛɛ munɛ le, le wu bɛɛ jiŋ yi nsa wuyu, njɛmɛ we nyu nchiɛɛŋ, wu kee lo lɛ wu jɛme nyu nchiɛɛŋ lɛ taŋlo bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ.
Mwɛɛ munɛ gɛ̀ kooshi lɛ fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le to fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ, “Gɛ kiŋkufɛ ke kimimia ba gɛ̀ ŋgode gɛ.”
Fi ka nyu ba saŋ kijusɛ kimu le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ, “Bamii lé bo gê bo jîiŋe muh wɛɛ wù ba le ba booŋ.”
Ba jiiyɛ Jiso

Ajiŋ ayu Yosɛf wu Alimatia ja wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Balɛt le wu lɛgɛ lɛ wu bɛɛŋ wu jo gvunɛ chi Jiso. Yosɛf wunɛ gɛ̀ bee muh ŋgoo yi Jiso le, geenɛ wù nyu gɛh ajiŋ ajiŋ nje wu gɛ̀ faane Bajuu. Balɛt bɛɛŋ, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ ki wu jô gvunɛ chiyu.
Nikodɛmu wù gɛ̀ ya wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Jiso le kintaŋ kimi le wu to tɛ bɛ mɛɛ ma gwee wuŋ bɛ alos ba taashɛ ba fiiŋsɛ, njijɛ wuyu gɛ̀ bee njɛ bakilu mbanshɛ ncho batɛde.
Bɛ wu shiishɛ gvunɛ chi Jiso, bo yefɛ bɛ mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ, ba baŋɛ bɛ nju, ba jiiyɛ wu no gɛ̀ bee a kinche ki woŋ wu Bajuu le.
Mwɛ wu kintaŋ wumu gɛ̀ bee mbebe fɛ ba gɛ̀ ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le fo. Mwɛ wuyu gɛ̀ bee jɛŋ yifiɛŋ nyu fo ba baaŋ muh yo a jiiyɛ gɛ.
Noo, no abvu gɛ̀ bee juu chi Bajuu chi Nseesɛ wu juu chi Yuuŋ, jɛŋ yiyu nyu tɛ mbebe le, bo mo bo leesɛ Jiso yo.

footnotes.text: Kfuu chi wunɛ kaŋ gɛ̀ bee ata a ba gɛ̀ choŋ ba noŋ ki ba yɛŋ muh wu le wu so le.
Isob wunɛ le jee chi kite kimi.
Bo gɛ̀ leese Jiso yo noo wu lɛ yuuŋ doo chi fe, bo mo bo to bo jiiyɛ wu chuule njiiyɛ wuboo le.
